integrity.proof_scope: All n>=5 and 2<=s<=n-2, integer Fourier frequencies only.
integrity.verification: Analytic proof plus 552 exact arithmetic tests and 11 alternate numerical integral checks.

scientific_limitations: The coefficient formula is stated only for no coordinate coincidences or exactly one pair; multiple collisions may exhibit further cancellations.
The sharp support count is leading-order for fixed n, not an exact finite-N count or a uniform n,N asymptotic.
Published general spline/polytope Fourier formulas could imply a nontrivial equivalent specialization not identified in bounded literature inspection.
title: Codimension-one integer Fourier support shared by hypersimplex slices
